eqlimmersive-skin-desc: Immersive dark-fantasy theme for EverQuest Legends Wiki.
eql-character-screenshot-owner-required: Only the account owner or a moderator may change files in this reserved Character image name. Unresolved or ambiguous account names require moderator review.
eql-character-screenshot-change-override: This screenshot override is not an image owned by this User page. Clear or change the screenshot parameter to an account-owned Character filename before uploading here; a new upload alone will not fix the override.
eql-character-screenshot-unowned-target: The selected image resolves to a shared or foreign target rather than this page's owned portrait. Upload an owned image and clear or repair the screenshot override or file redirect.
eql-character-screenshot-unavailable-tar: An unambiguous account-owned Character filename could not be selected. Review the User page and screenshot parameter, or ask a moderator for help.
